pages.title: Reading the chains
text: Every isotope in the mod is found or made in one of four ways:
CORE: irradiate it in the reactor, as fuel or in a target rod.
PLANT: reprocess or separate it in a machine.
A chain reads down: each arrow is one step, the half-life after a name is how long half of it takes to turn into the next. Y = years, d = days, h = hours, m = minutes, s = seconds.

pages.title: Uranium to plutonium
text: Burnt fuel and depleted uranium blankets breed plutonium. PLANT: the reprocessing plant gives plutonium nuggets; with depleted uranium they make MOX. Pu-241 decays (WAIT) into Am-241, which the isotope separator takes out as a capsule.

pages.title: Fission products
text: PLANT: the isotope separator takes Sr-90 and Cs-137 out of fission-product waste into capsules. They WAIT in the capsule: the decay is the heat an RTG turns into power. The caesium capsule is a strong gamma source; carry neither.

pages.title: Cobalt, lithium, silicon
text: Target rods: cobalt 72 h, lithium 168 h, silicon 24 h. Use the finished rod in your hand: a cobalt-60 sample, 1,250 tritium samples or neutron-doped silicon, and an empty casing back.

pages.title: Thorium to U-233
text: In thorium fuel this happens inside the assembly. In a thorium rod (casing + 1 thorium ingot, 168 h) it makes one U-233 Ingot, 480 g: fissile fuel, the driver of thorium fuel in place of enriched uranium. In the fabricator, 8, 12 or 19 U-233 and 4 thorium make a 2, 3 or 5 % assembly.

pages.title: Bismuth to polonium
text: Bismuth comes from uranium ore. Casing + 2 bismuth nuggets make the rod. The ingot is 82 mg of Po-210: 140 W per gram, an alpha emitter with almost no gamma, so it is safe to carry and good RTG fuel. It saturates: more time in the core adds nothing, and it halves every 138 days.

pages.title: Neptunium to plutonium-238
text: Depleted uranium rod, 240 h: 0.2 g of Np-237, at low yield. Casing + 8 neptunium ingots, 120 h: 0.28 g of Pu-238, 0.57 W per gram. Real Pu-238 starts from kilograms of reprocessed neptunium, so this route is slow.

pages.title: Radium to actinium
text: Casing + 8 radium. One rod gives 1 mg of Ac-227: 14.6 W per gram with its daughters, which are strong gamma sources. A tiny, hot, dangerous fuel.

pages.title: Thulium-170
text: Thulium is in the rare earths: casing + 8 rare earth concentrate. 19 g of Tm-170 per rod, 11.5 W per gram: the most power of any ingot, and gone in a year. Its beta particles make bremsstrahlung, so it reads strongly when carried.

pages.title: The uranium series
text: MINE it, then WAIT. This is why uranium ore gives radium (Ra-226) and lead (Pb-206). Bismuth is only a companion in the veins.

pages.title: The thorium series
text: MINE it, then WAIT. This is why thorium ore gives lead (Pb-208) and a little radium.
